Respondents Gurana Ayyalu Agencies vs State Of Ap on 24 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173699977/ 1 Whereas the Petitioner above named through its Advocate Sri.Taddi Nageswara Rao presented this Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased to issue a writ of mandamus. or any other appropriate writ or direction declaring the action of the respondent/police authorities in interfering with the business of tobacco products of the petitioner in any manner and booking criminal cases as illegal, arbitrary and, in violation of Articles 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondent/Police not to interfere with the petitioner's business pertaining to purchase, possession, transport and sale of Tobacco products governed under -The Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 in the interest of justice; And Whereas the High Court upon perusing the petition and affidavit filed herein and upon hearing the arguments of Sri. Taddi Nageswara Rao Advocate for the Petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Medical & Health for Respondent No.1 & 4, learned Gp for Home for Respondent Nos.2, 3, 5 to 8 and of Sri N.Harinath, learned Assistant Solicitor General for Respondent No.9, directed issue of notice to the Respondents herein to show cause as to why this Writ Petition should not be admitted.
